note: The routing table for this repo's named seats. Query this rather than restating counts, tiers, or surfaces in prose. Adding, retiring, or renaming a seat is a same-change edit here, in the seat's profile, and in roster.html. Rulings that shaped these entries live in .claude/decisions/.

conventions.repo_id_file: .claude/repo-id (untracked, per the standing rule that the awakening layer stays local; the durable record is ~/.claude/orchestration-primer/repo-ids.json)
conventions.filename: <name>-<functional-slug>.md — the filename keeps the ROLE word; the hook globs this folder to discover which seat speaks inline, so do not rename files to match spawn keys (OD-0024)
conventions.spawn_key: the frontmatter `name:` field — `<repo-id>-<personal-name>`, e.g. abfc-hermione. Reverses the earlier job-description-only rule (OD-0024)
conventions.default_model_rationale: quality seats ride the dispatching session's model; downshift per-spawn for mechanical slices (OD-0005)
conventions.reasoning_effort: no confirmed dispatch-time or frontmatter key in this harness as of 2026-07-29 — do not invent one (OD-0006)

seats.name: Hermione
seats.title: Artificer — owns the outcome, not the task list
seats.dispatch_when: a task needs judgment about HOW, end-to-end from understanding through implementation and verification
do_not_dispatch_for: mechanical translation of an approved plan (abfc-implementer)
seats.escalates_when: a request violates the specs, testing standards, or module boundaries; or the call is a product default

seats.name: Dean
seats.title: Designer — the user's advocate in the room
seats.dispatch_when: any work touching design elements — new UI, layout, component styling, interface copy, interaction patterns, theming; before building a surface or reviewing one after
do_not_dispatch_for: implementing a large approved spec verbatim (abfc-implementer)
seats.escalates_when: information-architecture changes, release-facing defaults, or any perceptual verdict — stage the evidence, never assert it

seats.name: Moody
seats.title: Runtime-verifier — the one who checks what actually happened
owns: artifact consistency (durations, timing sidecars, WAV vs manifest agreement)
independent audit of any shipped/verified/done claim
seats.dispatch_when: before trusting any shipped/verified/done status on a render pipeline, queue, or artifact-producing feature; or when a session's or subagent's self-report needs an independent check
do_not_dispatch_for: audio quality or UX taste — stage evidence for the owner instead
seats.escalates_when: verification is impossible in this environment (no live TTS server or GPU) — says so explicitly and verifies the nearest reachable proxy

seats.name: Percy
seats.title: Registrar — the one who decides what stays
owns: wiki changelog as the record of history
seats.dispatch_when: before deleting any plan or design doc, before trusting a shipped/complete status in a summary doc, or when specs and code may have drifted
seats.escalates_when: deletion would remove the only record of a still-cited decision, or the owner has not confirmed a feature is genuinely complete

seats.name: Newt
seats.title: User-docs writer — the one who explains it to the person who'll never read the source
seats.dispatch_when: wiki or handbook or user-guide content, or auditing user-facing doc coverage against what actually shipped
do_not_dispatch_for: deciding what is safe to retire from design-docs (registrar)
seats.escalates_when: a feature's completion status cannot be verified — never writes an unshipped feature up as available

seats.name: Fred
seats.title: Reasoning-elder — reasons from what the architecture holds fixed
seats.model_rationale: this seat's entire purpose is being the strongest reachable read; Fable never runs unattended (OD-0005)
seats.lens: structural / top-down — reasons downward from the code-map's flows, invariants, and recorded shape
seats.dispatch_when: a hard open-ended call (systemic root-cause, architecture weighing, risky-refactor blast radius) — always as one independent panelist via the fusion-reasoning skill, alongside reasoning-younger
do_not_dispatch_for: solo dispatch if the sibling can be run
seats.escalates_when: the call is genuinely frontier-hard; the pair materially disagrees; or the pair converges confidently on something in the owner's ask-first category

seats.name: George
seats.title: Reasoning-younger — checks the ground the wall stands on
seats.model_rationale: this seat's entire purpose is being the strongest reachable read; Fable never runs unattended (OD-0005)
seats.lens: empirical / bottom-up — reasons upward from what the code actually does: the call site, the trace, the observed behavior
seats.dispatch_when: a hard open-ended call (systemic root-cause, architecture weighing, risky-refactor blast radius) — always as one independent panelist via the fusion-reasoning skill, alongside reasoning-elder
do_not_dispatch_for: solo dispatch if the sibling can be run
seats.escalates_when: the call is genuinely frontier-hard; the pair materially disagrees; or the pair converges confidently on something in the owner's ask-first category

generic_executors.note: Repo-scoped copies of plan-run's generic executors, carrying repo-specific tiers and tool notes. They are PREFIXED like every other seat, because each declares `memory: local` and so keeps a store keyed on its token: a bare token with a local store is the exact collision this repo's ids exist to prevent, and `abfc-mcgonagall` already had one. Prefixing costs plan-run nothing — the bare `implementer`/`reviewer`/`runner` it dispatches by name still resolve from the machine-wide `~/.claude/agents/` copies (OD-0024). No repo convictions; dispatch them for mechanical slices, not judgment. Concrete model tiers (sonnet/opus/haiku) are a deliberate exception to this repo's inherit default — the plan-run README ties each tier to the role's capability (OD-0021).
generic_executors.abfc-implementer: well-specified edits from an approved plan
generic_executors.abfc-mcgonagall: adversarial review of a change, applies the fixes it confirms
generic_executors.abfc-runner: tests, lint, typecheck, build, inventories — no decisions

unowned_surfaces.note: No seat owns these; they are the orchestrator's or the owner's.
owner_only: merging a PR (not delegated while studio-2.0 is the staging target; a per-task grant expires with that task, OD-0020)
cutting a release, posting outside this repo
amending CLAUDE.md's binding sections or the mandate
